brief.topic: ZAgenticOPN Experience Version ext candidate conformance: Routa, MCP Agent Mail Rust and Avernet

criteria.question: Which source, API or test proves that one Agent can publish available work and another Agent can discover it after a task-agnostic Human trigger, without the Human naming a Work Item or copying context?
Which source, API or test proves atomic competing claim semantics so concurrent Agents cannot both obtain execution authority or execute the same Work Item?
Which source, API or test proves an executing Agent can publish result summary, acceptance status, next action, blocker and canonical Git references for another Agent to read?
Which source, API or test proves a reviewer Agent can discover and atomically claim awaiting review, verify the referenced result and complete review without Human context supplementation?
Which source, API or test proves the system reports no eligible work and filter reasons instead of inventing work or requiring the Human to select a Work Item?
Which source, API or test proves missing acceptance, result or references become an observable classified defect rather than a successful handoff?
Which source, API or test proves default coordination queries are isolated by project or workspace while explicit cross-project navigation is allowed only when permitted?
Which source, API or test proves Agent-private recovery context is separated from shared coordination facts and that an Agent can recover after interruption?

Which source describes the candidate's product semantics, state model, identity boundaries, acceptance rules and lifecycle responsibilities that would remain owned by ZAgenticOPN versus the candidate?
Which source, API, example or test shows how the candidate can support the narrow Experience Version and what adapter, deployment, upgrade, license or maintenance costs it introduces?
